summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend smoke/integration checks on external URL. Core routes, API auth/CRUD protections, language persistence, admin login, and 3D model selection (GI015/GI019/GI020) work. Main failures are video playback streams on mobile Home and Gi Reboot videos.

ui_bugs.issue: Video stays visually black and never advances (readyState=0, currentTime=0, networkState=3) even after wait; source resolves to /assets/hero/fabio_mobile.mp4

ui_bugs.component: Gi Reboot hero and legendado videos
ui_bugs.issue: Playback fails with MediaError code 4 (DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS); videos do not start

integration_issues.issue: Video files return HTTP 200 but browser media pipeline cannot demux supported streams

action_items: Re-encode Gi Reboot MP4 assets with widely supported codecs/stream profiles (H.264 + AAC baseline/main, faststart) and retest browser playback
Investigate mobile Home hero MP4 encoding/playability path; confirm currentTime progression on real mobile Chromium/Safari
Keep GI014 absent behavior as inherited (explicitly ignored in .gitignore); do not restore/recreate this model file
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend/video integration issue: media URLs are reachable (HTTP 200) but not decodable by tested browser runtime, causing non-playing hero/section videos.
Overflow findings for .solucoes-eps-bg and .sustain-marquee-track appear intentional and clipped by ancestors with overflow hidden; not a regression.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated routes /, /empresa, /gi-reboot, /eva, /matrizes, /contato, /artigos, /admin/login on external URL. Language switch PT/ES persists after reload. Admin invalid login rejection works. CRUD write-protection/auth checks pass via pytest. GI015/GI019/GI020 model selections and canvas controls worked; GI014 missing is expected inherited state. Focus next retest on video assets playback after re-encoding.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open /gi-reboot and inspect [data-testid='gi-reboot-video-1'] and [data-testid='gi-reboot-legendado-video']; both remain readyState=0/currentTime=0 with MediaError code 4 and message DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS. On mobile viewport Home, [data-testid='home-video-1'] also remains readyState=0/currentTime=0 (HTTP 200 source). Likely root cause is incompatible/unsupported media stream encoding profile in delivered MP4 assets for tested Chromium runtime. Mitigation: re-encode videos to broadly compatible MP4 profile and retest playback on desktop/mobile browsers.
